scope: Measured static build ZIP export and version-bound user Preview observations into existing authorized directed Review / owner Repair / remeasurement / follow-up. Not editable project export, release, or complete game quality.
implementation: Preview, feedback and export reuse one measured build selection and file-coverage implementation. No new server, project script, rebuild or model call for download.

Archive contains build/ original measured bytes and measurement.json only. Refuses stale sources/directories, uncovered/private/alias paths, unknown measurement versions, writers and Run version drift before returning the complete ZIP. Reuses BGS ZIP32 helper with UTF-8 names.

Authenticated Preview observations append to existing Run JSON, bound to actual Task/Attempt/artifact and confirmed requirement IDs. Same key/content is idempotent; observations are untrusted reports, not findings, commands, user authorization or closure claims.
Preparing review/repair plans requires existing agent.send_message project authority and current plan revision, and never dispatches native work. Actual task execution remains explicit per task.

Directed review receives only selected observations and owners of bound source files; every observation needs a disposition with actual finding links or concrete non-reproduction/out-of-scope reason. Reports retain original source/version/owner/impact/close requirements.

Repair uses original owner write scope; changed report/source/owner contracts require explicit affected replanning. Affected measured consumer waits for remeasurement; unrelated accepted tasks/history remain. Follow-up preserves prior links and needs current repair/consumer evidence, not another PASS claim.
Review evidence also pins current measured directory membership, preventing added files during Review from escaping final freshness.
Existing actual source-bound AskUserQuestion path is retained. An unresolved follow-up escalates; no automatic review loop or new native turn limits.

actualNativeEvidence.provider: Loopback deterministic fake model, not paid provider
actualNativeEvidence.observed: Real CLI Skill / Read / AskUserQuestion / Write / normal end; 3 distinct task native contexts, actual retained user answer, host rule-tests exit zero, actual static runtime-smoke before observation and after owner repair, follow-up checks. 12 provider requests in the native fixture.
actualNativeEvidence.limits: Not proof of LLM judgement, aesthetics, enjoyment or complete gameplay correctness.

server.note: Entire server is not typecheck-clean. Exact diagnostic lines match previous baseline.

failedExploration.finding: A long-running suite loaded earlier Review code before the newly edited directory-drift test. It returned failed rather than unverified for that new case.
failedExploration.resolution: Stopped editing that guard/test, ran focused closure then full suite again; verified logs retained separately. No ignored assertion or changed expected outcome.

limitations: deliveryEligible remains false. Static ZIP is not editable source project or whole-game acceptance; HTTP build/ root required, not file:// compatibility.
No Claude Code native source changes, real generated game file edits, paid test, deployment/restart, or real database migration.
Existing optional JSON Run persistence is used; local CAS/restart and HTTP protocol tested. Real database competition/recovery and deployment UI/download not verified.

Review semantics and inability to reproduce an issue are not independent proof that an issue is absent or fixed. Required Skills remain selectable via existing task contracts; native test proves loading, not correct professional application.
